label: Cinematic Orchestral / Epic Chinese Folk Fusion

cards.mood: The piece opens with a solitary, mournful atmosphere that establishes a sense of ancient vastness.
cards.palette: A traditional bowed string instrument (resembling an Erhu) carries the main melodic motif throughout the track, appearing in the intro, bridging sections, and soaring over the chorus.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Where the stone peaks touch the sky,
Ancient shadows stretch across the land,
Dust of ages settles in the wind,
Mountains stand like giants carved in jade.
[Pre-Chorus]
The river carves a path of grace,
Time flows deep within the earth's embrace.
[Chorus]
Rise like the dragon's waking breath,
Stand firm against the turning wheel,
Crown of gold on a throne of stone,
Power wakes in the heart of the wild.
[Verse]
Spirit burns like a steady flame,
Echoes of glory call the name,
Through the mist of the morning haze,
Pathways carved by a thousand deeds.
[Pre-Chorus]
The river carves a path of grace,
Time flows deep within the earth's embrace.
[Chorus]
Rise like the dragon's waking breath,
Stand firm against the turning wheel,
Crown of gold on a throne of stone,
Power wakes in the heart of the wild.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
One spark ignites the silent night,
One soul finds the truth in light.
[Chorus]
Rise like the dragon's waking breath,
Stand firm against the turning wheel,
Crown of gold on a throne of stone,
Power wakes in the heart of the wild.
[Outro]
